blocks.path: High blood pressure
s: High blood pressure (also called hypertension) can lead to serious problems like heart attacks or strokes.
But lifestyle changes and blood pressure medicines can help you stay healthy.

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Check if you're at risk of high blood pressure
s: High blood pressure is very common, especially in older adults.
There are usually no symptoms, so you may not realise you have it.

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Check if you're at risk of high blood pressure
s: Things that increase your chances of having high blood pressure include:

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Check if you're at risk of high blood pressure
s: your age – you're more likely to get high blood pressure as you get older

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Check if you're at risk of high blood pressure
s: having close relatives with high blood pressure

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Check if you're at risk of high blood pressure
s: your ethnicity – you're at higher risk if you have a Black African, Black Caribbean or South Asian ethnic background

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Check if you're at risk of high blood pressure
s: having an unhealthy diet – especially a diet that's high in salt

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Check if you're at risk of high blood pressure
s: being overweight

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Check if you're at risk of high blood pressure
s: smoking

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Check if you're at risk of high blood pressure
s: drinking too much alcohol

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Check if you're at risk of high blood pressure
s: feeling stressed over a long period

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Non-urgent advice: Get your blood pressure checked at a pharmacy or GP surgery if:
s: you think you might have high blood pressure or might be at risk of having high blood pressure

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Non-urgent advice: Get your blood pressure checked at a pharmacy or GP surgery if:
s: you're aged 40 or over and have not had your blood pressure checked for more than 5 years

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Non-urgent advice: Get your blood pressure checked at a pharmacy or GP surgery if:
s: Some pharmacies may charge for a blood pressure check.

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Non-urgent advice: Get your blood pressure checked at a pharmacy or GP surgery if:
s: Some workplaces also offer blood pressure checks.
Check with your employer.

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Non-urgent advice: Get your blood pressure checked at a pharmacy or GP surgery if: > Free pharmacy checks for over 40s
s: Many pharmacies offer free blood pressure checks for people aged 40 or over.

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Non-urgent advice: Get your blood pressure checked at a pharmacy or GP surgery if: > Free pharmacy checks for over 40s
s: Find a pharmacy that offers free blood pressure checks

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Symptoms of high blood pressure
s: High blood pressure does not usually cause any symptoms.

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Symptoms of high blood pressure
s: Many people have it without realising it.

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Symptoms of high blood pressure
s: Rarely, high blood pressure can cause symptoms such as:

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Symptoms of high blood pressure
s: headaches

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Symptoms of high blood pressure
s: blurred vision

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Symptoms of high blood pressure
s: chest pain

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Symptoms of high blood pressure
s: But the only way to find out if you have high blood pressure is to get your blood pressure checked.

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Urgent advice: Get help from NHS 111 if:
s: you often have headaches or blurred vision

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Urgent advice: Get help from NHS 111 if:
s: you have chest pain that comes and goes

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Urgent advice: Get help from NHS 111 if:
s: you have other symptoms you're worried could be caused by high blood pressure

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Urgent advice: Get help from NHS 111 if:
s: You can call 111 or get help from 111 online.

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Immediate action required: Call 999 if:
s: you get sudden pain or discomfort in your chest that does not go away – the pain can feel like squeezing or pressure inside your chest, burning or indigestion

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Immediate action required: Call 999 if:
s: you get pain that spreads to your left or right arm, or your neck, jaw, stomach or back

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Immediate action required: Call 999 if:
s: you have chest pain and you feel sweaty, sick, light headed or short of breath

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Immediate action required: Call 999 if:
s: You could be having a heart attack.
Call 999 straight away as you need immediate treatment in hospital.

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Immediate action required: Call 999 if:
s: Do not drive yourself to A&E.

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Immediate action required: Call 999 if:
s: The person you speak to at 999 will give you advice about what to do.

blocks.path: High blood pressure > What happens at a blood pressure check
s: A blood pressure test involves inflating a band (cuff) around your upper arm and measuring the pressure in your blood vessels.

blocks.path: High blood pressure > What happens at a blood pressure check
s: If the test shows you might have high blood pressure, you may be asked to:

blocks.path: High blood pressure > What happens at a blood pressure check
s: use a blood pressure monitor at home to check your blood pressure regularly over the next few days

blocks.path: High blood pressure > What happens at a blood pressure check
s: come back to your GP surgery a few days or weeks later to have your blood pressure checked again

blocks.path: High blood pressure > What happens at a blood pressure check
s: wear a portable monitor that takes regular readings over 24 hours

blocks.path: High blood pressure > What happens at a blood pressure check
s: This can confirm if you have high blood pressure.

blocks.path: High blood pressure > What happens at a blood pressure check > What your blood pressure reading means
s: Blood pressure readings are given as 2 numbers, with the first number higher than the second (for example, 130/80).

blocks.path: High blood pressure > What happens at a blood pressure check > What your blood pressure reading means
s: You're usually considered to have high blood pressure if your reading is:

blocks.path: High blood pressure > What happens at a blood pressure check > What your blood pressure reading means
s: 140/90 or higher when checked by a healthcare professional

blocks.path: High blood pressure > What happens at a blood pressure check > What your blood pressure reading means
s: 135/85 or higher when checked at home

blocks.path: High blood pressure > What happens at a blood pressure check > Check your blood pressure reading
s: Use our check your blood pressure reading tool to check what your blood pressure reading means, and get advice.

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Risks of having high blood pressure
s: If your blood pressure is too high, it puts extra strain on your blood vessels, heart and other organs, such as your brain, kidneys and eyes.

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Risks of having high blood pressure
s: If it's not treated, it can increase your risk of serious conditions such as:

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Risks of having high blood pressure
s: heart disease

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Risks of having high blood pressure
s: heart attacks

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Risks of having high blood pressure
s: strokes

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Risks of having high blood pressure
s: heart failure

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Risks of having high blood pressure
s: kidney disease

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Risks of having high blood pressure
s: vascular dementia

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Risks of having high blood pressure
s: Lowering your blood pressure even a small amount can help reduce your risk of these problems.

blocks.path: High blood pressure > How you can help lower your blood pressure
s: Healthy lifestyle changes can help lower your blood pressure.

blocks.path: High blood pressure > How you can help lower your blood pressure > Do have a healthy, balanced diet exercise regularly – aim to do at least 150 minutes of exercise a week lose weight if you're overweight Don’t
s: do not eat too much salt – avoid salty food or adding salt to your meals

blocks.path: High blood pressure > How you can help lower your blood pressure > Do have a healthy, balanced diet exercise regularly – aim to do at least 150 minutes of exercise a week lose weight if you're overweight Don’t
s: do not drink too much alcohol – avoid drinking more than 14 alcohol units a week on a regular basis

blocks.path: High blood pressure > How you can help lower your blood pressure > Do have a healthy, balanced diet exercise regularly – aim to do at least 150 minutes of exercise a week lose weight if you're overweight Don’t
s: do not drink too much caffeine – drinks high in caffeine include coffee, tea and cola

blocks.path: High blood pressure > How you can help lower your blood pressure > Do have a healthy, balanced diet exercise regularly – aim to do at least 150 minutes of exercise a week lose weight if you're overweight Don’t
s: do not smoke

blocks.path: High blood pressure > How you can help lower your blood pressure > NHS help to get healthy
s: NHS Better Health has free tools and support to help you lose weight, get active, quit smoking and drink less.

blocks.path: High blood pressure > How you can help lower your blood pressure > NHS help to get healthy
s: Visit the NHS Better Health website

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Medicines for high blood pressure
s: A GP will usually prescribe medicine for high blood pressure if:

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Medicines for high blood pressure
s: your blood pressure is very high

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Medicines for high blood pressure
s: you're at higher risk of problems linked to high blood pressure, such as a heart attack or stroke

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Medicines for high blood pressure
s: your blood pressure is still high after making healthy lifestyle changes

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Medicines for high blood pressure
s: There are lots of different medicines for high blood pressure.
The medicine recommended for you depends on things like how high your blood pressure is, your age and your ethnicity.

blocks.path: High blood pressure > Medicines for high blood pressure
s: Most blood pressure medicines are taken as tablets once a day.
You may need to take more than 1 medicine to keep your blood pressure under control.
